behaviors.description: A threshold (around) of the number type just given. One below its minimum or above its maximum is reported as around-outside.
behaviors.name: Around

otherwise.does: The names of a specification are checked next. Only the reserved name `status` is claimed so far (by reserved).
A column of a decision table is checked next: no value has been seen in it yet.

behaviors.description: One value of the column, by kind. A null value (the row does not use the column) is not counted.
behaviors.name: Cell

behaviors.description: A name is claimed, by data, a query without input, an asked answer, a part, or a command input. If it is already claimed, it is reported as name-collision, with what had claimed it, and stays claimed by that, unless both claims are shared ones by the same kind of owner (asked answers of different commands, inputs of different commands), which may share a name. Otherwise it is now claimed by this owner.
behaviors.name: Claim

behaviors.description: The column is over. If the values seen since the last BeginColumn are of more than one kind, it is reported as mixed-column. What was seen is kept until the next BeginColumn.
behaviors.name: EndColumn

behaviors.description: A condition that a query failed, with what is known of the query it names. If no such query is declared (neither asked by that name nor declared), it is reported as failure-unknown; otherwise, if the query cannot fail (no mayFail), as failure-not-may-fail; otherwise, if the query takes an input and was not asked by that name, as failure-not-asked. At most one is reported.
behaviors.name: Failure

otherwise.does: A query that declares a promise. If the kind of its answer cannot keep it (a structured value, an enumeration or a boolean never can; increasing cannot be kept by a string, nor fresh by a number; an integer can keep both), it is reported as promise-kind. Then, independently, a query that takes an input is reported as promise-input.

emits.onlyWhen: The kind of the query's answer cannot keep its promise

otherwise.does: A type, on its own (types inside it are given separately). An enumeration with no members is reported as empty-enum, and a oneOf with no variants as empty-one-of. A number type with both a minimum and a maximum, the minimum above the maximum, is reported as min-above-max. Every type replaces the minimum and maximum remembered for the thresholds that follow: those of a number type (if any), none for any other type.

emits.onlyWhen: The type is an enumeration with no members
The type is a oneOf with no variants
The type is a number type with both a minimum and a maximum, and the minimum is above the maximum

descriptions.component: Checks, one fact at a time, what a specification declares: types, decision-table columns, promises, failure conditions and names.
descriptions.data.boundedAbove: Whether the number type last given has a maximum.
descriptions.data.boundedBelow: Whether the number type last given has a minimum.
descriptions.data.claims: The names claimed so far, each with what claimed it.
descriptions.data.kinds: The kinds of the values seen so far in the column being checked (null not counted), each once.
descriptions.effects.Report: What was just given is wrong, for this reason. `owner` is what had already claimed the name (only for name-collision; empty otherwise).

claimsWithNew.description: The names claimed so far, followed by the name just claimed, with its owner

earlierOwner.description: What had already claimed the name just given; empty when it is not claimed

hasMaximum.description: Whether the type just given is a number type with a maximum

hasMinimum.description: Whether the type just given is a number type with a minimum

kindsWithCell.description: The kinds seen so far in the column, followed by the kind of the value just given

maximum.description: The maximum of the type just given when it is a number type with one; 0 otherwise

minimum.description: The minimum of the type just given when it is a number type with one; 0 otherwise

noKinds.description: An empty list: no kind seen

reservedClaims.description: A list holding only the name `status`, claimed by reserved
